summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the full watchlist path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus the auth layer (`db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`).  **What's actually correct** (contrary to the ticket's leading theory): - Every watchlist read/write (list, get, create, delete, add-item, remove-item) filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`, and `userId` comes only from a verified session token — never client-supplied. - There's no anonymous/guest fallba
